dog.description_text:
Meet Gilmore! She is a 2 year old 10 lb Maltese. This adorable fluffy girl is a surrender from Georgia. Gilmore would make a perfect addition to any home! She is easy-going, lovable, affectionate, and playful. She loves to be in company and will you be your new best friend! Whether it’s jumping on your lap while you’re scrolling your phone or squeezing behind you while you’re watching a show, Gilmore will be by your side. She is good with dogs, is an occasional barker and loves to play with toys. She is no shed. She is working on her potty manners and is getting better every day. Gilmore is a bit hesitant of men and needs patience and time to trust and love. 3 Keywords for-her would be affectionate, playful, and sweet. Her energy is 6. She has a good appetite and does well in the car. Get ready to fall in love!

All adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
